services.title: Lawn care and mowing
services.body: Lawns are cut, edged and cleaned up on a schedule so the yard never gets ahead of you.
services.alt: Worker on a flatbed trailer steadying root-balled evergreens ready to be planted out.

evidence.text: Company sign board staked on a grass verge at the roadside in front of a residential street.

services.title: Mulch and bed work
services.body: Beds are cleaned out, edged and mulched, and plantings are set where they will actually grow.
services.alt: Bluestone steps and a paver walk part way through construction on a bare earth slope.

evidence.text: Wide paver walkway curving from a driveway up to a front porch between clipped foundation shrubs.

services.title: Hardscape, patios and walkways
services.body: Base is compacted and screeded before a single paver or block goes down, which is why it stays level.
services.alt: Stepping stone path and mulched beds finished beside a detached garage, barrow still on the soil.

evidence.text: Wide paver walkway curving from a driveway up to a front porch between clipped foundation shrubs.

services.title: Drainage
services.body: Water is given somewhere to go, with pipe and grade set so it leaves the house instead of pooling against it.
services.alt: Foundation planting bed freshly mulched at a beige house with a young staked tree at the corner.

evidence.text: Drainage basin and blue pipework set into a wet excavation with spoil heaped alongside.

services.title: Tree and shrub trimming
services.body: Hedges and ornamentals are shaped and dead wood comes out so they fill in instead of going leggy.
services.alt: Excavated bank cut back behind a house with a barrow standing on the grass above.

evidence.text: Kidney shaped pool with a paver deck and a low seating wall backed by mature trees.

reviews.author: Becky Gomilla
reviews.text: Wall Landscape Services replaced our old railroad tie wall with a new block wall. Tom and his team removed the old wall, relocated our sprinkler irrigation heads, and installed new garden fencing per our request. Tom was reasonably priced, started the job on time, oversaw the work every day, kept our yard tidy, and was communicative throughout the project. He even re-seeded the yard after he was done. Our town engineering department stopped by to inspect the work and was happy with the construction. We are incredibly happy with the results and would definitely hire Tom and his team again.

reviews.author: Yi Cao
reviews.text: Exceptional Service from Tommy at Wall Landscape Services! I recently had the pleasure of working with Tommy from Wall Landscape Services, and I couldn't be more impressed! From start to finish, Tommy was the ultimate professional, knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely dedicated to delivering outstanding results. Tommy took the time to walk me through every step of the process, answering all my questions with expertise and never making me feel rushed. His attention to detail and deep understanding of landscaping truly set him apart. You can tell he takes real pride in his work. If you're looking for someone who is reliable, skilled, and a pleasure to work with, look no further than Tommy at Wall Landscape Services. Highly recommend, 10/10!

reviews.author: Darren Boch
reviews.text: I'm a repeat customer. Just had a second job done by Wall Landscaping, a beautiful cobblestone pathway. Last summer Tom Wall did our backyard patio pavers. We like the value and price, but most importantly we like quality of Tom's work and that he personally spends time on the job with his crew and is patient and understanding of what you want done. Receive many compliments from friends and family.

reviews.author: Kimberly Jacobson
reviews.text: Wall Landscape has done two projects for us to make our home better! And we will be hiring his services again for future projects. The reasons to hire Wall; 1. He treats you more than just a customer, 2. He ensures the project is done right and will offer suggestions to ensure your home project is done correctly, and 3. He truly cares about the work he does because he is on the job site himself! I could go on and on but trust me folks, he is the guy to hire for your home jobs/improvements.

reviews.author: Jason Kopec
reviews.text: I have used Tom at Wall Landscaping in the past for a landscape project and I was very happy with the quality of the work and pricing. Once again, Tom and crew did not disappoint. It was a big job and 2.5 days worth of solid work w/ a full crew. Along w/ the hardscape, we had Tom do the mulch, plant a new tree, trim all existing greenery. It looks amazing. We are beyond thrilled with our new walkway and patio. Tom provided us lots of advice as we were trying to decide on what exactly we wanted. He listed to our thoughts and provided his suggestions. We are so glad we did. We are so excited to have a huge entertaining area for friends and family as we continue to socially distance:) If you are thinking about a landscaping project, call Tom and get on his schedule. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Abdulla Sheikh
reviews.text: I 100% agree with all the reviews before me. Tom is an honest and trustworthy person. I was referred to him through a family member and I am really happy that I did. The crew showed up on time and the best part is they were enjoying what they were doing. He offered his advise on what we should be doing and by doing so he has won a customer for life.

reviews.author: Veena Menon
reviews.text: Thomas and the Crew did an awesome job building our new patio and the front walkway. It was very easy to work with Thomas to get the quote and schedule the work. He was very prompt replying to the emails and phone calls. The crew worked very efficiently and the entire work was done very professionally. And the crew was very friendly too. This company definitely deserves the 5 stars

reviews.author: Margherite Mise
reviews.text: Tommy far exceeded building my patio, stone steps, a stone wall and planting 11 arborvitae trees, roses and mulch. It was a huge job and they did it in torrential rain & mud! The team did not waver from their goal! I watched Tommy work with his team and learned that he has a sense of excellence that I've seen only in Masters. Tommy respectfully works with you to create your vision. I've been told by neighbors and friends that I "upgraded the neighborhood" with this gorgeous backyard...which is really now a garden. I've already hired Tommy for an additional landscape project. Thank you Tommy! See you soon.

reviews.author: gary manci
reviews.text: Amazing work done by wall landscaping , From start to finish everything went as planned. Very happy with the final Product. New paver sidewalks , new pavers around the pool, completely transformed the outside of my house. Wall Landscaping has completed many projects for my family. Would Highly recommend

reviews.author: Michael Green
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the patio and walkway installation completed by Tom’s team. From start to finish, this was a professionally managed project that exceeded my expectations in every way. Tom’s expertise and leadership made all the difference. He was present throughout the entire project, ensuring quality control and keeping everything running smoothly. His hands-on management style gave me complete confidence that the work was being done right. The entire crew was professional and worked with remarkable efficiency under his guidance. What impressed me most was the speed without compromising quality. They completed beautiful patio and walkways in just 3 days, which is incredibly fast considering the scope of the project. I was prepared for a much longer timeline, so this was a pleasant surprise. The craftsmanship is exceptional. The finished result has completely transformed the exterior of our home - it honestly looks like we have a brand new house. The attention to detail in both the patio and walkway construction is evident, and the overall aesthetic is exactly what we envisioned. I would highly recommend Tom’s team for any landscaping project. Professional management and team members, efficient execution, beautiful results, and completed ahead of schedule - you really can’t ask for more than that.

reviews.author: Svenja Sperlich
reviews.text: Wall did a pretty big project for us including a retaining wall, and stairs ending in a new patio. Tom has been on top of everything since day one. Tom and his crew did an outstanding job! All the details were communicated quickly and well, very professional. The wall, stairs and patio turned out amazing - they really did not disappoint! We would absolutely recommend working with Tom and his crew at Wall Landscaping and will hire them for future jobs!

reviews.author: Danielle Miranda
reviews.text: Wall Landscaping Services built my backyard patio and firepit at my new home. I have gotten so many compliments on what an amazing job they did! Tom is personable, amazing to work with, and very responsive. He was there to guide me through the process the entire way. Tom and his team are very professional and Tom was present with his team for the entire project. Everything that Tom promised was done exactly how he said. Tom provided me with an initial quote with everything listed and there were no surprises as far as any costs. I highly recommend Wall Landscaping Services. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Jessica Marcell
reviews.text: I found Wall Landscaping highly rated on Angie's List and they proved to be a fantastic choice. Tom is friendly, respectful and honest. He and his crew show up on time, work in a timely manner, leave the premise clean and do fantastic work. They are very knowledgeable about grading, landscaping, patio work and drainage. We had a patio put in and Tom walked us through every step- keeping us informed of timeline, picking out stone together and explaining to us his process and progress. When you need to talk with him, he responds immediately and is reasonably priced. It was a pleasure working with Tom and his crew. I highly recommend them and hope to continue to use them in the future.

reviews.author: Michael Mui
reviews.text: Tom is very detailed, honest and professional. He was so helpful in trying to obtain a variance to build a patio in my backyard. He was so knowledgeable in dealing with town engineers and was even willing to attend a board meeting with me. If I do any projects on my house Tom is the one I will call.

reviews.author: Dan Marion
reviews.text: Everyone to date providing 5 stars is no fluke! Tom and his crew did an exceptional job with a drainage issue across our front lawn. The curtain he installed on the bottom of our driveway looks fantastic and the job took less than 1-1/2 days. Highly recommend Tom for your next landscaping project. This is the second time I used him. On a personal note, I had an opportunity to listen to Tom interact with his staff. Wow! His instructions were clear and his approach was very inviting. When employees are treated with respect, they go out of their way to perform. I think it's a win-win-win...for the employees, for Tom, and for his customers!

reviews.author: Janet Napolitano
reviews.text: Tom Wall and crew just completed the replacement of our front concrete apron and sidewalk - looks excellent! They worked quickly and efficiently over the span of 2 days (1/2 day each). Tom was very responsive over email throughout the whole process and oversaw the whole job. Would highly recommend and will use again for our next job!

reviews.author: Mike V
reviews.text: We’ve had several projects completed by Wall Landscaping Services including a new backyard patio and walkway, full drainage system, shrub removal, river rock installation, and Spring cleanup. They also hand-dug a 6-foot long by 4-foot wide by 6-foot deep hole in the front lawn to locate the waste/sewer pipe leading to the street in order for the town’s Sewer department to repair the faulty pipe. Once the pipe repair was completed by the town’s Sewer Department, Tommy and his team returned to our home and carefully back-filled the hole with the dirt they removed. Each project was top-notch. Tommy and his team of qualified, trained professional landscapers arrived on time, were very efficient, thorough, careful, and friendly. Since everything was exactly planned out and explained during the initial estimate, there were no surprises or hidden fees along the way. Tommy was on the job site along with his team every minute of each project to both supervise and work alongside his crew. He and his team go above and beyond each time and is highly recommended for all of your landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Justin and Gina
reviews.text: We are so happy that we worked with Wall Landscape Services for our recent front yard project! We called Wall Landscape Services in the early spring to get a quote for excavation and installation of two retaining walls (to widen our driveway) and a paver walkway (from the driveway to the front door). Tom came out to do the quote, and it was obvious that he is a knowledgeable professional in his field. He was able to understand our vision and improve upon it based on his years of experience. The quote was within budget and we decided to go ahead with the project. Tom communicated with us every step of the way, from filling out the appropriate paperwork and getting permits from the town, to helping us pick the best stone styles, to being on site with his crew every day making sure everything was done right and answering all of our questions. The Wall crew was professional and completed the project quickly. The end result looks even better than we imagined! We highly recommend Wall Landscape Services and look forward to working with them again for future projects.

reviews.author: Michael Lavelle
reviews.text: Tom does the spring mulch and fall clean-ups, and has planted shrubs and even dug a trench for electric wires. Always on time, very responsive to text/email, takes his time, explains everything, the guys work hard, and it looks great every time. Thanks Tom!

reviews.author: Lisa Saladino
reviews.text: This will be my second season working with Tom and his team. He is exactly the type of business owner I want to work with. He follows up and gets the job done right. I just had spring cleanup done and the yard looks great. I love that he showed up with his team to make sure I was happy and ask if I had any additional needs. I highly recommend this business!!

reviews.author: Ed Party
reviews.text: Tom Wall and his construction crew are a hard working terrific group of experts. Tom Wall is honest, dependable and enjoyable to work with. From estimates to project design to material procurement and worksite supervision he’s got things under control. It’s nice to see the boss working on the projects too. Tom has been doing landscape and hardscape projects at my home for several years. From installing a porch to sod to planting beds and shrubs to paver walks to a fence and a patio, each of the projects were designed in accordance with my requirements and executed on time and within budget. Any additions to the projects were handled with ease and at a reasonable cost, or in some cases no cost. After my lawn projects were completed, Tom Wall’s Maintenance Division started taking care of the weekly grass cutting at a competitive cost. From project estimation to execution to maintenance you can’t go wrong with Wall’s Landscaping.

reviews.author: Virginia Donnellon
reviews.text: Tom and his crew replaced our bluestone walk and large patio with pavers this past summer. We were very happy with the results. They arrived on time every day, were very professional, and Tom went out of his way to make sure we were happy with the work. We would highly recommend Tom's company to anyone considering a similar project.

reviews.author: Karen O'Malley
reviews.text: If we could give Wall Landscaping 10 stars we would do it! Thomas Wall has great customer service, and was prompt in returning emails, texts, and phone calls. His crew was very professional. The job they did was to take out our old patio and creating a beautiful paver patio and walkway, as well as plant bushes and re-seed the grass. The seams in the patio are precise and tight, the gradual slope for drainage is accurate, and the craftsmanship is excellent. We can not stop looking at our new outdoor space we will be using for years and years. We highly recommend this landscaping service. The price we received was competitive. We thought we definitely got the most for our money.

reviews.author: toddej
reviews.text: Tom and crew just left after 4 days of working at my home. They installed a beautiful rock wall, created a paver pathway from the driveway up to the front steps that they had overlayed with stone and pavers. They mulched and did a full clean-up of my yard. I was very impressed with their work and it was a real pleasure working with Tom. I would strongly recommend Wall Landscape Services.

reviews.author: Jennifer Kerwin
reviews.text: Thank you Tommy and team our retaining wall , front steps, and flowerbeds ! Everything looks amazing !! we are getting So many compliments!! You have been great to work with from the moment we signed the contract to the end of the project! You were always available every day supervising the project from start to finish! Always available for questions , and great at explaining! We will recommend you and team to all our friends and family! Can’t wait for our future spring projects with you. !! Thanks so much

reviews.author: Amy Spalluto
reviews.text: I just have to give the biggest shoutout to Tommy and his team at Wall Landscaping for the beautiful work they did on our front and side gardens! They installed granite begian block permanent edging, created two flower beds and transplanted my healthy flowers and plants both there and around our front tree! Such quality work and attention to detail... we are SO HAPPY!!

reviews.author: Jen Ginsberg
reviews.text: Wall Landscape Services recently renovated the entire front of my property. Tom graded the downslope of the property with a beautiful paver walkway, retaining walls and patio. It looks awesome! It was a challenging project that was handled with the utmost professionalism and expertise. He exceeded all expectations. He was on time, worked diligently and managed the project onsite to completion. We appreciated his candor and guidance throughout the process. Tom is both knowledgeable and passionate about landscape architecture. I highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: Roger Gundersen
reviews.text: Wall landscaping is a top notch company. I’ve been working with Tom Wall for years. Besides being a great person, his work is immaculate.

reviews.author: Vincent Lombardozzi
reviews.text: Wall Landscaping is hands down the premiere Hardscape/maintenance company. Along with myself and referrals to other customers him and his guys are gifted at what they do. Toms experience in the industry shows it with his craftsmanship and endless knowledge on hardscape construction. Thank you for your services!

reviews.author: Andrew Jacobs
reviews.text: Tom and his crew have been maintaining my yard for about 8-9 years now and I have recommended him to many neighbors who love his service as well. Very responsive, fairly priced and does a great job!

reviews.author: Soto Apostolopoulos
reviews.text: Wall Landscaping is the one for you! They've been keeping my property looking neat and maintained for almost a year. They've been doing a clean, professional job, and Tommy gets back to you promptly (unlike others). But it doesn't stop there. I decided to hire them to do a big job installing privacy trees in the front and back, bury the gutter leaders under ground, make beds, put down cedar mulch, repair pavers & powerwash, install a new paver section, and most of all install new turf stone in the driveway. Besides the job being competitively priced... it was completed ahead of schedule without a snag, and more important it all came out fantastic!

reviews.author: Brian Favia
reviews.text: Tom and his crew did an amazing job building our front stoop and walkway. The price was right, inspections went well and the final product looks beautiful. We would highly recommend them for any masonry work you may need.

reviews.author: Bruce Seidner
reviews.text: Wall landscaping has been taking care of my properties for several years. They do a fantastic job and are very responsive. When putting my house on the market they spruced it up quickly and the house sold in one day! They are great. Highly recommended

reviews.author: James Cooper
reviews.text: Excellent work. We had our retaining wall done. Very professional. Owner took the time to go over the scale of work. Thank you again. We appreciate you.

reviews.author: Kathleen Barnum
reviews.text: Tom and his crew did an amazing job fixing our draining issue. Great to work with, very efficient, friendly, fairly priced. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bryan Wall
reviews.text: Tommy and his crew installed a stone paver patio at our home years ago, and his held up solid, very impressed with the design and quality. Would highly recommend using them for any landscape/hardscape needs

reviews.author: Tyler Cerbo
reviews.text: Wall landscaping is the go to spot. Local business with a great owner who’s very vested in the community. High quality work with immense attention to detail. From routine maintenance to high end installations this company is top notch.

reviews.author: Kevin Macken
reviews.text: After owning a business in the industry for over 20 years, it’s great to see the quality of work that Tommy provides his clients. I would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Dj Vallauri
reviews.text: Great experience. We had sod installed and Thomas @ Wall Landacaping delivered what he promised. Didn’t cut corner and was very professional. I would definitely recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Ryan Brown
reviews.text: Tommy is excellent and very precise with his work. He is honest, reliable, and offers great pricing.

reviews.author: Chuck G
reviews.text: I have used wall landscaping for 2 projects and both came out amazing. Reliable, honest and great pricing.

reviews.author: Dr Liz Nissim
reviews.text: Wall Landscaping Services just completed a property drainage system around my house that exceeded all of my expectations. He was on the job the entire time and completed the work himself. He takes on one job at a time. Did I mention that he is meticulous? He started early and worked for the duration of the day in order to complete the job in the 3 days that he promised it would take. I would highly, highly recommend Wall Landscaping!
